headline: Recommended a new Theater/Drama Club student activity account and FY 26 student activity balances, and approved $111,000 in budget transfers.
summary: The subcommittee discussed student activity accounts, special education items, and future meeting locations. It voted on student activity accounts and three budget transfers, and it asked for follow-up on school bus crossing arms.
decisions: Recommended unanimously to the full School Committee the establishment of a new Student Activity Account for the Gloucester High School Theater/Drama Club.
Recommended unanimously to the full School Committee approval of the Student Activities, their objectives, and balances as presented.

Approved unanimously three budget transfers as presented: $20,000 from School Lunch Districtwide Equipment to School Lunch Districtwide Food Supply, $75,000 from Transportation to Special Education Contracted Service, and $16,000 from Business Office Districtwide Supplies to Business Office Districtwide Contracted Services.

decision_evidence.quote: On a motion by Ms. Clancy, seconded by Mr. Melvin, it was unanimously VOTED: To recommend to the full School Committee the establishment of a new Student Activity Account for the Gloucester High School Theater/Drama Club, pursuant to M.G.L., Chapter 71, Section 47.

On a motion by Ms. Clancy, seconded by Mr. Melvin, it was unanimously VOTED: To recommend to the full School Committee to approve the Student Activities, their objectives, and balances as presented, pursuant to M.G.L., Chapter 71, Section 47.

On a motion by Ms. Clancy, seconded by Mr. Melvin, it was unanimously VOTED: To vote the following budget transfers as presented: TO: School Lunch Districtwide Food Supply FROM: School Lunch Districtwide Equipment AMOUNT: $20,000 ... AMOUNT: $16,000

Our mission is for all students to be successful, engaged, lifelong learners. 
Building & Finance Subcommittee Meeting Minutes 
Wednesday, October 7, 2026 
Gloucester High School Library and via Zoom 
32 Leslie O. Johnson Road, Gloucester, MA 01930 
5:00 p.m. 
Members Present  Administration Present 
Melissa Teixeira Prince, Chairperson Amy Pasquarello, Superintendent  
Kathleen Clancy, Vice Chairperson Cody Marshall, Chief Financial Officer 
William Melvin, Member Saskia Nugent, Director of Finance  
Mike Jarvis, Special Education Director 
This meeting was conducted with the School Committee in person 
and the public participating in person and remotely via Zoom. 
I. CALL TO ORDER – Chairperson Teixeira Prince called the meeting to order at 5:05 p.m.
Effective August 16, 2023, the public is welcome to attend in person.  Alternatively, the
public may attend through the zoom link provided on the agenda.  The meeting notice
will reflect if the meeting is Zoom only.  As the recent amendments to the Open Meeting
Law allows, the Subcommittee may continue to hold meetings remotely.  Please note the
in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if technological problems interrupt
the remote connection.
